id: 定时器-A-周期模式-重复计数
title: 定时器 A 周期模式（重复计数）
description: The following example configures TimerA0 in periodic mode and toggles GPIO every 2s using the repeat count feature. NOTE: The repeat count feature is specific to the TimerA0 instance, and not the other TimerA instances. The device remains in SLEEP mode while waiting for an interrupt.（SDK 例程：tima_timer_mode_periodic_repeat_count）
